text:
alex.p: quick follow-up on the topology-aware decision cache RFC — want to lock down eviction/TTL semantics before we roll to prod :eyes:
rita: SG. main concern is stale decisions routing traffic to a drained region during failover windows. we saw that in canary last week.
shan: yep. observed ~30s of misrouted traffic when region affinity cache hadn't expired. we should avoid absolute TTLs == bad.
alex.p: proposal: keep per-decision metadata: {region_hint, score_snapshot, created_at, version} and apply a dual-check on use: ttl + live-compat-check. if live-compat-check fails, fallback to re-eval.
dave: can you sketch the live-compat-check? sounds like an extra RPC that could add latency.
alex.p: it's lightweight — check current region health bitmask from region-status cache (in-memory). if region not eligible, treat decision as invalid. no remote RPC per request.
kevin: but region-status cache itself is eventually consistent. race still possible. suggest exponential backoff re-eval: first invalid -> immediate local re-eval; if still bad -> short cooldown (200ms) then re-eval with fresh topology.
rita: +1 to cooldown to avoid thundering herd on re-eval. also add jitter.
lia: what about cost/latency score drift? a cached decision made under different load patterns could be suboptimal but not incorrect. do we want proactive invalidation when score delta > threshold?
shan: yes — track score_snapshot and when we compute a new candidate, if live score differs by > X% we either re-rank or mark stale. X default 20%.
ops-bot: deployment: decision-cache 1.3.0 rolled to canary at 2045123000.
dave: ops-bot noted canary id. saw two requests bounced to fallback during test window.
alex.p: edge case: what if the model variant is temporarily unavailable in the region but remains in cache as preferred? need version-aware compatibility check. version mismatch -> immediate invalidation.
kevin: implementation note: make compatibility checks cheap bitmask ops. store per-decision compatible_variants bitmask. bitwise AND with runtime-available mask. if zero -> invalid.
rita: metrics we need: cached-hit-rate, cached-stale-invalidations, avg-reval-latency, reval-thundering-alerts. add histogram for stale_age at invalidation.
lia: for SLA guarantees we should bias towards safety over cost. if decision cache returns ambiguous result, prefer fallback that meets latency SLO.
shan: agree. we have customer-facing SLOs. misrouting that increases p99 is worse than extra re-evals.
dave: rollout plan: feature flag gated, canary region only, ramp 10%/50%/100% over 48h with auto-rollback if cached-stale-invalidations > 0.5% or reval-latency p95 > 100ms.
ilia: (typo) -> lia: fyi we should also add debug logging for invalidation reasons: TTL, variant-mismatch, region-unavailable, score-drift. log sampling 1% to avoid noise.
alex.p: thanks — i'll update the RFC with: 1) per-decision metadata 2) live-compat bitmask checks 3) score-drift threshold 4) cooldown + jitter for re-eval 5) metrics and rollout thresholds 6) debug sampling.
kevin: small nit — make default TTL conservative: 60s for edge-affinity, 10s for load-balancer hints.
rita: can we centralize config in an env-set so we don't redeploy to tweak thresholds?
shan: yes, use config service feature-flags and expose via console for engops.
dave: will own the rollout and alerts. ping me when RFC updated.
alex.p: pushed updated RFC draft and PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rfcs/482/topology-decision-cache [link]. PTAL and comment. :thumbsup: 
kevin: reviewed quick pass, left one comment about unit tests for the mask logic.
lia: i'll add a small e2e that simulates region flip and asserts no misroutes.
rita: ack. next steps: merge RFC, land canary flag, monitor metrics, iterate.
ops-bot: CI: test-suite passed for branch topic/cache-compat (build 7634).
